notes.title: Major Update:
notes.notes:
Now supports V-sync up to 120 Hz at all monitor resolutions
 Improved day and night cycle
 Lights and shadows are now visible over infinite distance
 Improved "Next Gen" Unreal Engine 4 Post Processing
 The endless final m00n has been further improved
 Extra enemies & further improved Alien AI

notes.title: Minor patch:
notes.notes:
Save every m00n.
 Overall faster gameplay.
 Increased firepower & damage per second with all ships.
 Difficulty adjusted on difficult "Easy", "Normal" & "Hard".
 More "Spheres" per ship on difficult "Easy".
 Improved "Arcade Mode".

notes.title: Major Update: 4K / 10K , UHD, HDR & Ultra-Wide-Screen
notes.notes:
Supports now:

 4K (UHD-1) and 8K (UHD-2) with HDR in "Big Picture" mode on Ultra High Definition Televisions
 Ultra-Wide-Screens (16:9 / 21:9 / 32:9) as well as UW-UHD 1440p, UW 4K, UW 5K and UW 10K
 Improved Texture-Resolutions up to 4K per Texture and improved shader model for DirectX and Metal.

notes.title: Minor bug and improvement patch
notes.notes:
"Do the tutorial first" warning implemented
 Minor game improvements
 Fixed mouse problem in the tutorials
